t: You're looking at Aubrey House, a large eighteenth-century detached house on Campden Hill in Holland Park, standing in two acres of gardens. It's a private residence, so you're seeing it from outside. Its owners have included the radical politician Peter Alfred Taylor, and the art collector and banker William Cleverley Alexander. His daughter Rachel Alexander lived here too, and became a social campaigner in Kensington, helping found charities including the Kensington Housing Trust and the North Kensington Community Centre. More recently, the philanthropist and publisher Sigrid Rausing lived here and owned it.
